headline: EPS grows far faster than revenue on margin gains
summary_short: ON Semiconductor reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.60B, up 9.2% y/y, with diluted EPS of $0.56 swinging from a $0.08 per-share loss last quarter and up 36.6% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue rose 6.0% q/q and 9.2% y/y to $1.60B, while GAAP diluted EPS of $0.56 swung from a $0.08 per-share loss last quarter and rose 36.6% y/y — four times faster than revenue growth — on gross-margin expansion and disciplined cost management. Gross profit was $616.3M (+5.7% q/q, +11.7% y/y); operating income swung to $258.6M from a $53.4M q/q loss (+33.7% y/y); net income was $226.8M, also swinging from a q/q loss (+33.2% y/y). Free cash flow quadrupled y/y to $425.4M. For Q3 2026, onsemi guided non-GAAP revenue of $1,650-1,750M, gross margin of 39.9-41.9%, and diluted EPS of $0.79-0.91.
confidence_notes: EPS and operating-income q/q deltas are expressed as dollar amounts rather than percentages because the prior quarter's base was negative (a loss), making a percent change not meaningful.

drivers.explanation: Strengthening demand, particularly across AI-driven applications, and growing customer adoption of onsemi's differentiated solutions including Treo and high-voltage power products.
Gross-margin expansion and disciplined cost management drove EPS growth four times faster than revenue; results came in above the midpoint of prior guidance.
Management now expects AI data-center revenue to more than double in 2026 and guided Q3 2026 non-GAAP revenue of $1,650-1,750M, gross margin of 39.9-41.9%, and diluted EPS of $0.79-0.91.
